desc:
Guts & Blackpowder is a game taking place during the Napoleonic Wars with the undead zombie masses rising from the ground. A group of survivors must hold out against the horde, only armed with muskets and swords. 

Clothing in the game is made by DrLivesey, Miscreantagent, and Ower, you can buy their clothing here 
https://www.roblox.com/groups/5466526/DrLiveseys 
https://www.roblox.com/groups/33978264
https://www.roblox.com/groups/33800174

UGC Hats Available! https://www.roblox.com/groups/16911831/Guts-Blackpowder#!/store

GAME RULES:
1. Exploiting is strictly forbidden and will result in permanent ban
2. Inappropriate chat messages and user-built structures are not allowed and will result in bans
3. Griefing, round delaying, stalling, or abusing glitches to intentionally ruin the game for other users will result in bans
4. Misusing the in-game reporter can result in bans
5. Adhere to Roblox's Terms of Use

badges.name: Old Yeller
badges.desc: Put a survivor who's broken their legs out of their misery.

badges.name: Cold Front
badges.desc: Successfully escape Vardohus Fortress in objective mode IN ONE LIFE.

badges.name: Explosive Retreat
badges.desc: Successfully escape Leipzig in objective mode IN ONE LIFE.

badges.name: Slight Miscalculation
badges.desc: Get blown up by the bridge explosion in Leipzig.

badges.name: Recruited by The Empire of the Dead
badges.desc: By dying in the Paris Catacombs your body becomes part of the Empire of The Dead.

badges.name: Deliverance from the Catacombs
badges.desc: Successfully escape Catacombes de Paris in objective mode IN ONE LIFE.

badges.name: Soldats de ma Vieille Garde
badges.desc:
(Badge may require to rejoin, or to press P multiple times)
In order to get this badge, you must complete the following tasks:

1. Get a KDR of 10 or above.
2. Save 51 teammates from being grabbed by a zombie.
3. Stay alive for 35 rounds, without restarting, on Endless. It can start at any wave, just as long as you stay alive for 35 rounds in total.
4. Win 30 times or above in the campaign mode.
5. Acquire the following badges: Old Yeller, Cold Front, Explosive Retreat, and Deliverance from the Catacombs.

This unlocks the Old Guard Regiment under France.

badges.name: Forlorn Hope
badges.desc: Successfully escape San Sebastián in objective mode IN ONE LIFE.

badges.name: Vos Enterrement
badges.desc: Lower the platform for your team using the winch so they can escape on San Sebastián.

badges.name: GIVE 'EM STEEL
badges.desc:
Kill 10 zombies with the Bayonet charge only. 
Requires Officer's "Charge" ability to be active.

badges.name: NO, FREDERICK!
badges.desc:
Hit (and most likely die) to a bomber while in a Bayonet charge.
Requires Officer's "Charge" ability to be active.

badges.name: Soldier's Grace
badges.desc:
Given to those whom sacrificed themselves for the betterment of their fellow soldier.
Obtaining this badge unlocks Chaplain and the Cross Necklace.

To unlock this achievement, you must:
- Save 150 teammates from being grabbed.
- Kill 75 runners pinning your teammate.
- Obtain the badge "Vos Enterrement".
- Heal teammates over 50 times (as Surgeon).

badges.name: Glory to the Survivors
badges.desc:
Survive a campaign map (with the exception of Vardohus Fortress) with half of the server (10 players total) still on their first life.
Requires 10+ players in order to obtain.

Obtaining this badge unlocks the Battle Scar accessory.

badges.name: For Whom The Bell Tolls
badges.desc:
Beat the Halloween map "Sleepy Hollow" without dying.

Obtaining this badge unlocks the Jack-o'-lantern Utility.

badges.name: Confederation of the Undead
badges.desc: Successfully survive Kaub in objective mode IN ONE LIFE.

badges.name: Beresinalied
badges.desc: Successfully defend/build the bridge in Berezina. This badge is based off contribution to building the bridge, or doing enough to support your team.

badges.name: Dur à Cuire
badges.desc:
Rewards you with the 1e Grenadiers.

Requirements:
10 hours of playtime
2000 kills
20 campaign wins

badges.name: The Most Terrible Night
badges.desc: Successfully escape Copenhagen in objective mode IN ONE LIFE.

badges.name: Rule Britannia!
badges.desc:
Britannia rules the canal!

Die to the crew of the British Brig-Sloop in Copenhagen in Objective Mode.

badges.name: If I Had a Brain
badges.desc: Get crushed by the falling drawbridge in Kaub.

badges.name: Stop that useless noise!
badges.desc: "You'll hurt yourself."

badges.name: Don't Give Up the Ship
badges.desc: Successfully escape Roscoff in objective mode IN ONE LIFE.

badges.name: Search and Rescue
badges.desc: Successfully escort the diplomat and escape Roscoff alive, playing from the beginning of the map.

badges.name: Rejoice, St. Petersburg!
badges.desc: Successfully survive all 10 waves and defend Saint Petersburg in HOLDOUT mode.

badges.name: No Match for a Flintlock
badges.desc: Put down a Cuirassier Zombie in a sword duel by shooting it in the head.
